project.title: HeyPCB LED Art
project.summary: Shaped LED boards inspired by films: stars, ghosts, cats, rockets, gears, moons, saucers and shields, each in its own colour. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.

boards.title: HeyPCB Full Moon
boards.role: Full Moon LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white full-moon disc with a ring of light: the full moon behind the castle in a monster film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Paw Print
boards.role: Paw Print LED art, purple mask
boards.summary: A purple paw print that lights toe by toe, for the hero dog of a family adventure film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Clockwork
boards.summary: A black clockwork gear whose single lit tooth ticks round like a time-travel clock.

boards.title: HeyPCB Heartbeat
boards.summary: A red heart whose outline beats like the hospital monitor in a medical drama: slow and steady, faster when you tap MODE.

boards.title: HeyPCB Castle Key
boards.role: Castle Key LED art, black mask
boards.summary: A black key to the castle gate in a medieval film, lit in torch orange.

boards.title: HeyPCB Chest Reactor
boards.role: Chest Reactor LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A round white board with a ring of LEDs around a hole in the middle: the arc-light chest piece from a hundred superhero props, made as a real circuit you can wear over a T-shirt.

boards.title: HeyPCB Crescent
boards.summary: A purple crescent moon lit along its curve: the full-moon-is-coming shot of every werewolf film, gentle enough for a bedroom.

boards.title: HeyPCB Crystal
boards.summary: A purple diamond crystal with light running up its facets: the power crystal every fantasy quest is chasing.

boards.title: HeyPCB Deep Sea
boards.role: Deep Sea LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A blue fish lit along its fins like the glowing creatures of a deep-sea documentary.

boards.title: HeyPCB Donut
boards.summary: A purple ring with a 32 mm hole, its LEDs chasing round like a portal opening in a sci-fi film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Eclipse
boards.summary: A black ring with a 48 mm hole, lit round its rim like the corona of a solar eclipse in a cosmic film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Saucer
boards.summary: A green flying saucer with running lights round its rim and dome: the drive-in alien invasion, landed on your desk.

boards.title: HeyPCB Forest
boards.summary: A green leaf with a glowing edge, from the enchanted forest of an animated film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Galaxy
boards.summary: A purple eight-point star whose light spirals out like a galaxy on a starship's viewscreen.

boards.title: HeyPCB Ghost Ship
boards.role: Ghost Ship LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white flying saucer that pulses a slow beam, for the alien-encounter film set on a quiet farm.

boards.title: HeyPCB Ghost Trap
boards.role: Ghost Trap LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white ghost with LEDs around its wavy hem, for the night after a ghost-hunting film: it breathes slowly, then flickers when you press MODE.

boards.title: HeyPCB Haunted
boards.summary: A black house outline whose eaves flicker like candlelight, for the night after a haunted-house film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Coin
boards.summary: A yellow seven-sided coin from a pirate's treasure chest, with a lit rim that glints.

boards.title: HeyPCB Hero Shield
boards.role: Hero Shield LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A blue shield with a lit rim: the hero-crest badge of a hundred adventure films, chained to a second board through its OUT header.

boards.title: HeyPCB Hive Cell
boards.role: Hive Cell LED art, yellow mask
boards.summary: A yellow hexagon with LEDs round its edge: one cell of a honeycomb wall, like the alien hive in a creature feature. Chain several with the OUT header.

boards.title: HeyPCB Hyperdrive
boards.summary: A black octagon whose LEDs spin up like a starship engine before the jump to lightspeed: the cockpit-panel moment of every space film, as a desk light.

boards.title: HeyPCB Neon Kitty
boards.role: Neon Kitty LED art, red mask
boards.summary: A red cat-head sign that glows like the neon over a rainy street in a cyberpunk film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Knight
boards.summary: A black shield for the knight in a medieval epic, with a rim that glows like torchlight.

boards.title: HeyPCB Koi
boards.summary: A red koi that swims colour along its body, from the garden pond of a quiet drama.

boards.title: HeyPCB Love Letter
boards.role: Love Letter LED art, purple mask
boards.summary: A smaller purple heart for a love-letter film: tape it inside a card and it glows when the button is pressed.

boards.title: HeyPCB Midnight Cat
boards.role: Midnight Cat LED art, black mask
boards.summary: A black cat-head night light whose outline glows like a cat's eyes in a dark alley in an old noir film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Monarch
boards.summary: A yellow butterfly whose wings ripple with colour, like the opening shot of a nature documentary.

boards.title: HeyPCB Moon Rocket
boards.role: Moon Rocket LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white retro rocket with a fin-to-nose LED outline: the silver-screen moon ship from a 1950s B-movie, as a shelf light.

boards.title: HeyPCB Nebula
boards.summary: A purple cloud-shaped nebula that drifts through colours, like a deep-space backdrop.

boards.title: HeyPCB Night Wing
boards.role: Night Wing LED art, black mask
boards.summary: A black bat with LEDs along both wings, for the rooftop silhouette in every caped-crusader film: it sweeps light from wingtip to wingtip.

boards.title: HeyPCB Boo
boards.summary: A smaller purple ghost that jumps from dim to bright when you press MODE: a jump-scare in a pocket.

boards.title: HeyPCB Orbit
boards.summary: A black ringed planet whose ring lights chase round like a moon in orbit.

boards.title: HeyPCB Pentagon
boards.summary: A green pentagon with a running-light rim: the summoning sign from a horror film, harmless and bright.

boards.title: HeyPCB Skull
boards.summary: A black skull with a glowing outline, for the night after a pirate film: it glows green or red, your choice in firmware.

boards.title: HeyPCB Red Star
boards.role: Red Star LED art, red mask
boards.summary: A five-point star in red solder mask with thirty RGB LEDs tracing its outline: the kind of hero emblem a film costume department would glue to a chest plate.

boards.title: HeyPCB Rock Pick
boards.role: Rock Pick LED art, black mask
boards.summary: A black guitar-pick board that flashes along its edge: the encore light from every rock-concert film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Jewel
boards.summary: A red diamond: the ruby at the centre of every jewel-heist film, lit like it is under the museum spotlight.

boards.title: HeyPCB Sheriff
boards.summary: A yellow six-point star with a lit rim: the sheriff's badge from every western, as a pin that glows at sundown.

boards.title: HeyPCB Skeleton Key
boards.role: Skeleton Key LED art, yellow mask
boards.summary: A yellow skeleton key lit from bow to bit: the key to the locked room in every mystery film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Snowflake
boards.summary: A white six-point snowflake that sparkles cold blue: the first-snow scene of a winter film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Halt
boards.summary: A red octagon whose outline flashes like the warning lights in a heist film when the alarm trips.

boards.title: HeyPCB Storm Cloud
boards.role: Storm Cloud LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white cloud whose outline glows and flickers like lightning: the storm rolling in over the farmhouse in a disaster film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Tin Robot
boards.role: Tin Robot LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A white robot head with an antenna and ears, lit round its edge like the friendly robot sidekick in a family sci-fi film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Little Green
boards.role: Little Green LED art, black mask
boards.summary: A black saucer whose running lights blink green, for the night the visitors land in the cornfield.

boards.title: HeyPCB Vampire
boards.summary: A red bat for a gothic vampire film, glowing deep red with a slow heartbeat.

boards.title: HeyPCB Engine Room
boards.role: Engine Room LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A blue gear with a hub hole, its LEDs running around the teeth like the boiler-room dials in a steampunk adventure film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Wizard
boards.summary: A blue seven-point star like the ones on a wizard's robe in a fantasy film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Winter Tree
boards.role: Winter Tree LED art, green mask
boards.summary: A green pine tree that twinkles in colours, for the holiday film that plays every December.
